svg.title: One task, three candidate models, shared review
svg.desc: An illustrative evaluation scene, not a measured routing system. A task tray connects to stepped Carbon, Argon and Hydrogen workstations on a single isometric base. Light packets sequentially travel to a candidate, its processing surface lights up, then an output travels to the review bench. Each candidate is reviewed against the same standard. All paths and labels remain visible with reduced motion.
svg.text: Three models, one standard of review
